▶ Watch the Doc
Behind The Dream · A Tropical Dreams Documentary Short · 2025
Behind The Dream
Behind the Dream is a short documentary that explores the energy, history, and community behind Mutiny Events rave Tropical Dreams, at the Sturbridge Host Hotel in Massachusetts. Inspired by the spirit of the late-90s and early-2000s rave era, Tropical Dreams is where music, creativity, and connection come together, creating a world where people can express themselves and dance to amazing music. Through interviews, event footage, and personal stories, Behind the Dream captures the heart of the thriving New England underground dance community and the passion that keeps it alive.
Filmed and Edited by: Jonathan Santarelli
Produced by: Three 4ths Media

Cameras
Sony FX6  ·  A7Siii

Lenses
7Artisans 50mm T2.0 Spectrum Prime Cine Lens
Rokinon 35mm 1.4  ·  Sony G 24-105mm 4.0

For inquiries: threefourthsmedia@gmail.com
